_doc: Pirate line (#168), first job (#186). Rank equals canonical Skill.wz level. Costs, damage, counts, boxes, range, actions, art and sounds are tier A unless overridden next to the entry. Canonical prerequisites are ignored (tier C owner choice #31). Dash (#188) is the first manual buff. Second jobs: passives and boosters #189 (Improve MaxHP, Knuckler/Gun Mastery, Knuckler/Gun Booster; their cards require the exact branch), Brawler attacks #191 (Backspin Blow, Double Uppercut, Corkscrew Blow), Gunslinger attacks #192, MP Recovery #193, Oak Barrel #194.

flash_fist.name: Flash Fist
flash_fist.desc: Punches one monster in front of you.
flash_fist._tier: Tier A: canonical box, damage, mpCon, mobCount, straight action and CharLevel art. Tier C: knuckle requirement, auto-cast at one front target, cooldown 0.9s and action hold 0.6s; untuned.

somersault_kick.name: Somersault Kick
somersault_kick._tier: Tier A: canonical box reach and height, damage, mpCon, mobCount, somersault action and CharLevel art. Tier C: any weapon, auto-cast on one target, cast.around mirrors the box's far edge across the player to strike around, cooldown 1.6s and action hold 0.6s; untuned.

double_shot.name: Double Shot
double_shot.desc: Fires two bullets at nearby monsters.
double_shot._tier: Tier A: gun requirement (WZ weapon-space key), bulletCount, range, damage, mpCon, doublefire action and CharLevel art. Tier C: auto-cast at nearest targets, cooldown 1s, action hold 0.6s, speed 600 px/s, radius 8px and no base pierce; untuned. Range and shot count come from WZ rather than survivor copies.

bullet_time.name: Bullet Time
bullet_time.desc: Increases accuracy and avoidability. Accuracy also raises critical chance.

improve_maxhp.name: Improve MaxHP
improve_maxhp.desc: Increases the Max HP gained at each level-up.

text.desc: Boosts the Max HP you gain at each level-up.
text.h: Each level-up gives +{x} more Max HP

improve_maxhp._passive: Tier B: like Improved MaxHP Increase, the canonical x (3 to 30) is added to the Max HP of each level-up at the skill's rank then; never retroactive. The AP half of the skill (y per HP AP) has no meaning here (AP is automatic). Tier A: 10 levels, any weapon.

knuckler_mastery.name: Knuckler Mastery
knuckler_mastery.desc: Increases the mastery and accuracy of Knucklers.
knuckler_mastery._passive: Tier A: canonical mastery N (mastery (10 + 5N)%) and x (ACC), 20 levels. Tier C: knuckle-only tag (String.wz says so; the family tag is ours). Tier B: mastery encoding and ACC feeding crit chance, as in 7.6.

gun_mastery.name: Gun Mastery
gun_mastery.desc: Increases the mastery and accuracy of Guns.

text.desc: Boosts the accuracy and the mastery of your Guns. This skill only applies when you equip a Gun.

gun_mastery._passive: Tier A: canonical mastery N and x (ACC), 20 levels. Tier C: gun-only tag. The canonical y (bullets per recharge) has no meaning here: ammo is endless (6.1.2), so it is neither used nor shown.

knuckler_booster.name: Knuckler Booster
knuckler_booster.desc: Temporarily increases the attack speed of Knucklers.
knuckler_booster._buff: Tier A: canonical x (-2: two attack speed steps faster, hence scale -1), time (10 to 200 s), hpCon and mpCon (29 down to 10, both paid per cast), the alert2 action, effect art and Use sound. Tier C: knuckle only (String.wz text; family tag ours), self-only auto-cast while inactive and affordable, recast on expiry (7.7), 0.8 s cast hold.

backspin_blow.name: Backspin Blow
backspin_blow.desc: Slides back and elbows up to 3 monsters, stunning them.

text.desc: Slide back and elbow the monsters around you to damage and briefly stun them.
text.h: MP -{mp_cost}; damage {damage}%, up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}, stun for 1 sec.

backspin_blow._tier: Tier A: canonical damage 88 to 240%, mpCon 12 to 30, mobCount 3, time 1 (the stun), the backspin action, effect/hit art, Use and Hit sounds, and the box height and 140 px reach. Skill.wz has no prop, so every landed hit stuns (bosses resist, see Monster statuses and elements in GAME_DESIGN). Tier C: knuckle requirement (the WZ node names no weapon); the canonical box lies behind the facing, so cast.around mirrors it to both sides and the attack strikes the nearest mobs on either side, then the character turns to the nearest one and slides 100 px away from it after the hits (7.9), stopping at platform edges and walls; cooldown 1.5 s and action hold 0.8 s; untuned.

double_uppercut.name: Double Uppercut
double_uppercut.desc: Two quick punches that damage and stun the monster in front of you.

text.desc: Two quick punches to damage and briefly stun a monster within your knuckler's reach.
text.h: MP -{mp_cost}; damage {damage}% x {attack_count}, up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}, stun for 1 sec.

double_uppercut._tier: Tier A: canonical damage 100 to 290%, attackCount 2, mpCon 15 to 30, time 1 (the stun), the doubleupper action, effect/hit art, Use and Hit sounds. Skill.wz has no prop, so every landed hit stuns (bosses resist). Tier C: knuckle requirement; the level has no box or mobCount, so it follows the Power Strike rule: it strikes one monster inside the knuckle's swing envelope (the basic attack's reach), more only from cards; cooldown 1.2 s and action hold 1.0 s; untuned.

corkscrew_blow.name: Corkscrew Blow
corkscrew_blow.desc: Charges forward and punches up to 3 monsters on the way.

text.desc: Run forward and punch the monsters in your path.
text.h: MP -{mp_cost}; damage {damage}%, up to {mob_count|monster|monsters}, charges forward.

corkscrew_blow._tier: Tier A: canonical damage 135 to 420%, mpCon 20 to 36, mobCount 3, the box reach 100 to 200 px (also the charge distance: displacement.distances copies -lt.x per level, checked against Skill.wz by a test) and height, the screw action, effect/hit art, Use and Hit sounds. Tier C: knuckle requirement; a mob in the box starts a full charge toward it (no prepare/keydown wind-up, the Loop sound is not played) that strikes up to mobCount mobs along the swept path (7.9) and stops at platform edges and walls; cooldown 2.0 s and action hold 0.8 s; untuned.

gun_booster.name: Gun Booster
gun_booster.desc: Temporarily increases the firing speed of Guns.
gun_booster._buff: Tier A: canonical x (-2: two attack speed steps faster, hence scale -1), time (10 to 200 s), hpCon and mpCon (29 down to 10, both paid per cast), the alert2 action, effect art and Use sound. Tier C: gun only (String.wz text; family tag ours), self-only auto-cast while inactive and affordable, recast on expiry (7.7), 0.8 s cast hold.

dash.name: Dash
dash.desc: Press its skill key to run faster and jump higher for a while.

text.desc: Press the Dash key to temporarily raise your movement speed and jump.

dash._buff: Tier A: canonical mpCon, speed x, jump y and time per level 1-10, the effect art and the use sound. Tier C (owner): a manual skill on its skill key (default X) instead of v83's double-tap, usable with any weapon, recast on the key once the buff ends, no cast hold. Speed and jump follow the movement caps (140 speed, 123 jump).
dash._manual: Tier C: the bot dashes when its HP is below bot_flee_hp of the maximum with a mob within the flee distance, or when at least bot_surround_count mobs on its level are within bot_surround_distance px.

mp_recovery.name: MP Recovery
mp_recovery.desc: Turns some of your HP into MP when your MP runs low and your HP is high.

text.desc: Turns part of your Max HP into MP when your MP runs low and your HP is high.
text.h: Pays {x}% of Max HP, recovers {y}% of it as MP; {cooldown} sec. between uses

mp_recovery._tier: Tier A: pay share x (10% of MaxHP), MP share y (55-100% of the HP paid), cooltime (70-25 s), recovery action and effect art, no weapon requirement. Tier C (owner, #168 grilling): it auto-casts only while MP is below 30% of MaxMP and HP is at least 75% of MaxHP before paying, needs no monster, rounds the HP paid to whole points (the MP gained down), and never leaves 0 HP; action hold 0.6s; untuned.
